citywide.note: The tally's 48.6% is its respondents' mix (K, 5th, 6th, 9th and mixed classes), not every grade. The model's all-students figure weights the grade curve by CDE Census Day enrolment by grade (data/school-case/enrolment-sf.json) at the schools modelled, with grades 10-12 held at 9th's 33%; Trend continues the 6th-9th line instead. The tally basis is 48.6 plus the modelled change in each band's car share weighted by the tally's respondent weights.

v0GoDutchCeiling.note: V0 (notes/school-trips-2026-10/2026-10-18-v0-pct-fit.md): Go Dutch on SF's pairs at today's distances. The High case at full network sits above it where a grade's own constant is above its level's reference (TK, K), since that extra part is kept.

cases.rule: lambda x caseD x max(0, on_v - on_today); caseD = Go Dutch shift - the level's SF reference

bikeCurve.gradient: routed (0.80% of pairs on the straight-line proxy)

ulezTest.note: points of driven grade 1-4 children leaving the family car at the ULEZ charge on the non-compliant share of cars, against CHILL's London-over-Luton gap; keys are form|daily vehicle trips the charge is split over (1 = the school trip pays it all)

origins.note: Origins are census children x the tract's public share of enrolled students (ACS B14002); each SFUSD-run school's students by home ZIP are then raked to SFUSD's dashboard per grade span, so the home-ZIP check below is fitted, not a test. Fig. 5 and Stanford's mean are checks the rake never sees.
